title: Available field officers within 5 km of an incident

steps.title: Pick the incident
steps.text: The join condition pins the query to incident 1, so every officer is compared with a single point.

steps.title: Filter role and availability
steps.text: Officer B is unavailable and Manager D is a regional manager, so both are rejected before any distance is computed.

steps.title: Distance within 5 km
steps.text: The GiST index narrows candidates by bounding box, then exact spheroid distance decides. Officer A is about 1.5 km away. Officer C is about 5.9 km away and is rejected.

steps.title: Sort and return
steps.text: The remaining officer is returned with the distance in meters.

title: Nearest 3 active incidents to an officer

steps.title: Keep active incidents
steps.text: Incidents 2 and 5 are resolved and are dropped. Incidents 1, 3 and 4 are still active.

steps.title: Nearest-first ordering
steps.text: The <-> operator lets the GiST index return incidents in distance order, so PostgreSQL does not sort every row.

steps.title: Limit and return
steps.text: LIMIT 3 keeps the three closest incidents.

steps.title: Read the polygons
steps.text: Each zone boundary is read from the zones table.

steps.title: Measure the area
steps.text: ST_Area on a geography column returns square meters on the spheroid. Dividing by 1,000,000 converts to square kilometers.

steps.title: Sort and return
steps.text: Zones are ordered from largest to smallest.

title: Animal pairs within 1 km of each other
sql: JOIN animal a2 ON a1.animal_id < a2.animal_id
JOIN species sp1 ON sp1.species_id = a1.species_id
JOIN species sp2 ON sp2.species_id = a2.species_id

steps.title: Two copies of animal
steps.text: The table is read twice, as a1 and a2.

steps.title: Each pair once
steps.text: a1.animal_id < a2.animal_id removes self pairs and mirrored duplicates, leaving 6 pairs out of 16.

steps.title: Distance filter
steps.text: Only animals 1 and 4 are within 1 km, about 770 m apart. Animals 2 and 3 are about 3 km apart and every other pair is farther still.

steps.title: Attach species
steps.text: Both animals are resolved to their species names.

title: Users within 2 km of an active incident

steps.title: Keep active incidents
steps.text: Incidents 2 and 5 are resolved and are rejected. Incidents 1, 3 and 4 remain.

steps.title: Test users against each incident
steps.text: User 3 is about 1.1 km from incident 1 and 1.5 km from incident 3. Users 1 and 2 are farther than 2 km from every active incident.

steps.title: Distinct and sort
steps.text: Each user and incident pair appears once, ordered by user and then distance.
